arguments.name: services
arguments.description: Service resources to create, each an object with name, kind (Service), action (CREATE), source (YAML file to copy) and repository (target YAML file).

arguments.name: routes
arguments.description: Route resources to create, each an object with name, kind (Route), action (CREATE), source (YAML file to copy) and repository (target YAML file).

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: True when every Service and Route resource was created.

outputs.name: resources_processed
outputs.description: Number of Service and Route resources processed.

outputs.name: resources_succeeded
outputs.description: Number of resources whose YAML file was created.

outputs.name: changes
outputs.description: Number of YAML files written to the repository.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error objects ({message}) for the resources that failed.
